observations.behavior: Adds a conditional removal of supplied team_id and an override check for personal_api_key staff users before setting properties.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how attribution metadata (team_id) is assigned to LLM events; could affect billing or reporting accuracy depending on auth context.

observations.behavior: Removes explicit fallback behavior where caller-supplied team_id always overrides authentication-derived identity unless explicitly allowed by OAuth/OAuth-like credentials.
observations.posthog_connection: Restricts the ability of callers to attribute usage to arbitrary teams without meeting specific credential requirements. This could prevent misattribution but also potentially block legitimate shared-key use cases.

observations.behavior: Replaces unconditional assignment with checks against authenticated user's authorization status, including whether they are staff and their authentication method.
observations.posthog_connection: Tightens access control around event attribution, requiring either trusted server identities or explicit opt-in via headers rather than allowing any caller to set team_id freely.
